name: Megan Holdings Limited
summary: Megan Holdings Limited, established in 2020 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, focuses on the creation, construction, and ongoing upkeep of aquaculture and agriculture facilities throughout the country. Their operations further encompass the provision of industrial equipment, leasing services for agricultural and aquacultural machinery, and comprehensive enhancement and maintenance of farm infrastructure. The company operates as a subsidiary of Star Sprite Limited.
